lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: There is a trailer on the north side with a crate of notebooks in it that came down from the campus and never went back.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Foreman has a work order to burn them Friday. I asked why and was told it was a work order, which is not an answer, which is why I am telling you.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: That is four years of my handwriting. They took the bench notes when they took the vote.

choices.text: You remember the work. Let the paper go.
